entries.title: Fixed Cloud Head and Double Curved Ruyi Scepter
entries.description: One newly authored complete uninscribed ruyi-inspired cultural ornament, lying in a static side-rest display pose. A broad whole cloud-like head has a deep central upper notch, two rounded upper lobes, flowing lower shoulders, a finite bevelled edge and a gently convex plain front. One entire slender handle follows two opposing lateral curves and widens into an integral tapered flared terminal; its upper end is buried within the head. The head and terminal have finite resting faces. All numerical outline points, swept sections, terminal, head relief and contacts are newly authored together, not an extracted burnisher hook or a molinillo with rings removed. The rounded-hook burnisher has a straight turned grip and narrow crooked stone root, while the ringed stirrer is axially radial with retaining shoulders; neither provides this broad notched cloud head and double-curved complete staff organization. Two closed editable whole meshes, four opaque constant wood-look PBR roles, metre scale, native Z up and whole horizontal bounds centred. One complete independent model zero scenes. Category-level visual inspiration only, not a replica of a particular museum object, named artist, dynasty, historical proportion, precious material or ritual implement. No inscriptions, religious symbols, patterned inlay, tassel, separate stand, actual wood species, luck or spiritual efficacy, authentic cultural use, handling, balance, manufacturing or safety claim. Hidden root overlap is a static visual attachment, not a joinery specification. No rig, animation or interaction.
